name: Single Exhaust System with Polished Tip; Side Exit (07-13 5.3L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: 2013SilvZ71
visible.title: Solid budget option.
visible.body: If you are looking at this exhaust, then you are probably worried about price. For the money, this is a decent option. The pipes are stainless with good build quality. For a crew cab, short bed Silverado, it fit perfect which was a major concern of mine. There is an extra hanger (second back from the front of the truck) that is unused. Now, the downfall of this exhaust, the connection point of the exhaust to the y-pipe does not include a clamp; so, you will need to reuse yours. It is also large enough that even with said clamp applied, it is loose over the y-pipe exit. This causes it to rattle while idling. Luckily, I have a welder and a tack weld resolved this problem. The major concern is muffler. I am pretty sure a Coke can has thicker side walls than this muffler. I did not even install the muffler as looking it over I deduced I would be wasting my time. Thing has rather poor looking welds and rattles just being turned over in my hands. My fix to this was to order a 14" Flowmaster and installing a 9" long cheater piece of stainless exhaust tubing to fill in the rest of the exhaust. Overall, this exhaust is great for those with a tight budget; but, know that there is a reason it is cheap. Knowing what I know now, I would still order again. The sound (with the Flowmaster) is nice and deep. When you get on it, it lets people know that your truck has an aftermarket system. At idle, it sounds pretty close to stock.
visible.product: Single Exhaust System with Polished Tip; Side Exit (07-13 5.3L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: DrewW
visible.title: Exhausted... ??
visible.body: Not bad very easy just a little welding I didn't use the clamps, don't believe in those things but yeah again not bad all for good price ...
visible.product: Single Exhaust System with Polished Tip; Side Exit (07-13 5.3L Silverado 1500)

visible.title: Looks and Sounds good.
visible.body: Replaced and old dual exhaust setup that was really loud. This one sounds great. Had to cut the flex pipe and weld onto this one for it to mount up but other than that it was a easy install.
visible.product: Single Exhaust System with Polished Tip; Side Exit (07-13 5.3L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: NickelCity
visible.title: 09 Silverado cat back exhaust
visible.body: This was a great exhaust system. Easy to install and sounds great. For the money you can't beat it.
visible.product: Single Exhaust System with Polished Tip; Side Exit (07-13 4.8L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: Tom323
visible.title: Just what I needed.
visible.body: I bought a used truck and realized that previous owner cut off muffler and pieced together a crappy exhaust. I bought this system based on reviews and price. The the pipes and clamps are very thick, the muffler is pretty thin and light weight, but it does the job for now. System installed easy enough on my Silverado and has a nice rumble in acceleration but fairly quiet during idle. Very satisfied with the purchase.
visible.product: Single Exhaust System with Polished Tip; Side Exit (07-13 5.3L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: CareerMechanic
visible.title: Great Pipes, Bad Muffler
visible.body: Only 3 out of 5 because of the low price. The good: The pipes are high quality and beautiful stainless! The bad: Muffler has a rice-burner rattle at 3,500 (loudest during tow/haul upshift and sounds absolutely terrible) That's not a preference, that's a fact. If you buy this exhaust system, buy a better muffler. I'm going to upgrade to a Borlja or Magnaflow. Also, this kit does NOT come with a new exhaust V-band style clamp. The factory band is stainless, but the bolt is not. So you'll have to get a new bolt OR buy a new V-band to install. One last thing, you'll see the exhaust kit for the crew cab has one random extra exhaust hanger that needs to be cut off or it'll rub the fuel tank. It's in a place where the factory exhaust doesn't even have one. The back hanger is also at an odd angle and to keep the correct clearance between the rear shock the frame, the hanger barely reaches the hanger. It's wonky... Oh.. and one more thing. The welded exhaust hanger mounts are way smaller than factory. The barbs pop in and out freely, and my rubber hangers are in perfect condition.
visible.product: Single Exhaust System with Polished Tip; Side Exit (07-13 5.3L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: Dadiammark
visible.title: Exhaust system review
visible.body: Nice product. Pipes were perfect fit muffler makes tin rattling sound when truck shifts gears. Not happy about the muffler. Feels flimsy will change muffler soon.
visible.product: Single Exhaust System with Polished Tip; Side Exit (07-13 5.3L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: Fasted54
visible.title: Great sound
visible.body: Easy install. Great price! Glad I purchased. I used a lift so it was very easy. Only had to cut about 8” off to get old out. Low rumble. Just what I was looking for. I like the stainless too.
visible.product: Single Exhaust System with Polished Tip; Side Exit (07-13 5.3L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: Kas
visible.title: Nice for the price
visible.body: Perfect fit ,and nice finish. Nice mild rumble. The muffler is a straight through perforated core.. Does NOT come with the stock V-band for the converter joint. Cut the bolt and reuse your old one or make sure you order a new one. Took about half an hour to install after removing the old one with a sawzall.
visible.product: Single Exhaust System with Polished Tip; Side Exit (07-13 5.3L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: Slippery
visible.title: Best exhaust for the money
visible.body: Installed this system and fired it up. Took 30 minutes to disassemble the stock exhaust and install this exhaust. Sounds good with no popping or cab drone.
visible.product: Single Exhaust System with Polished Tip; Side Exit (07-13 5.3L Silverado 1500)

low_same_part_other_truck.author: Jonathon
low_same_part_other_truck.title: DOES NOT FIT
low_same_part_other_truck.body: 2000 F150 5.4, As read in other reviews. THIS IS NOT A BOLT IN PIPE. An adapter and hanger modification is required.
low_same_part_other_truck.product: Single Exhaust System with Polished Tip; Side Exit (97-03 5.4L F-150)

low_same_part_other_truck.author: Seth
low_same_part_other_truck.title: Terribly loud.
low_same_part_other_truck.body: Terribly loud. Horrible droning anytime engine is over 1500 rpm, concerning rattling when you really step on it. Don't buy this if you like to hear your music. Appears to be stainless but is much thinner than stock.
low_same_part_other_truck.product: Single Exhaust System with Polished Tip; Side Exit (07-13 5.3L Sierra 1500)

low_same_part_other_truck.author: Jacob G
low_same_part_other_truck.title: Not great quality
low_same_part_other_truck.body: At first it was great sounded great looked nice then about 6 weeks later I have the muffler coming apart on the inside. Something came loose inside the muffler now it has a terrible rattle. Now looking at new mufflers to get it off my truck.
low_same_part_other_truck.product: Single Exhaust System with Polished Tip; Side Exit (11-14 5.0L F-150)

low_same_part_other_truck.author: Caleb
low_same_part_other_truck.title: Didn’t come with flange and hangers don’t line up
low_same_part_other_truck.body: Ordered for my 2008 sierra 1500 Didn’t come with a flange to bolt it to the outlet after the cats, I had to weld the old flange onto the new exhaust Hangers don’t all line up Sounds like a trumpet at certain rpm It’s a decent kit for the price but came with some custom fabrications I had to do Sounds good except for the trumpet sound at higher rpm
low_same_part_other_truck.product: Single Exhaust System with Polished Tip; Side Exit (07-13 4.8L Sierra 1500)

low_same_part_other_truck.author: DonaldE
low_same_part_other_truck.title: Better off to buy one that fits !
low_same_part_other_truck.body: Installed it on my 02 F150. Required a lot of modifications in order to fit that cost double what I paid for the system. Made in China , I guess that's what we can expect. Works good and sounds decent once it's installed. I think the truck has more power and slightly better gas mileage than before.
low_same_part_other_truck.product: Single Exhaust System with Polished Tip; Side Exit (97-03 5.4L F-150)

low_same_part_other_truck.author: 945oh
low_same_part_other_truck.title: Solid
low_same_part_other_truck.body: Sounds amazing when paired with long tubes. It’s a DNA motoring catback and the hanger locations are not correct I believe it’s actually for an 11th gen truck. Not American Trucks fault though. Overall solid product sounds good just doesn’t fit without modification.
low_same_part_other_truck.product: Single Exhaust System with Polished Tip; Side Exit (97-03 5.4L F-150)

low_same_part_other_truck.author: JeffPogue
low_same_part_other_truck.title: 2002 F150 4.6 Single Exhaust System Installation
low_same_part_other_truck.body: At this low price, I didn't expect much. However, the overall quality was very good with the exception of the rearmost pipe hanger, it was totally welded in the wrong place, not even close. I just heated the errant hanger with a torch and bent it as close as possible and adapted the rubber mount to fit. I love the sound of it and the subsequent gas mileage increase was remarkable.
low_same_part_other_truck.product: Single Exhaust System with Polished Tip; Side Exit (97-03 4.6L F-150)

low_same_part_other_truck.author: Camdaddy805
low_same_part_other_truck.title: BEWARE
low_same_part_other_truck.body: This does not fit 2003 5.4 f150 like stated. Had to pay a shop to install it. Because it requires a 2.5 to 3 inch adapter and the hangers all had to be cut and remounted to fit the existing hangers. Sound is good. Quiet at idle but when you get above 3k rpm’s it has a nice deep aggressive rumble which I like. Would have been 5 stars if it fit correctly.
low_same_part_other_truck.product: Single Exhaust System with Polished Tip; Side Exit (97-03 5.4L F-150)

low_same_part_other_truck.author: Ondubsdriver
low_same_part_other_truck.title: 98 f150 catback exhaust
low_same_part_other_truck.body: Stan here,I ordered a catback exhaust from my truck. I had exhaust masters here in my hometown install it,took 2 hours to do it. My only issue is that it was flanged at the front by the converters on my truck,and my truck isn't flanged,so had to make a custom piece so it be installed,also the hangers were backwards to what was needed to install it,the shop had to cut off the existing ones and make new ones n weld them on. The sound is a nice low rumble,but not annoying so i like it alot over the factory system.
low_same_part_other_truck.product: Single Exhaust System with Polished Tip; Side Exit (97-03 5.4L F-150)
